title: Cloud identity — least-privilege enforcement
summary: Periodic and event-driven review of cloud identities (IAM roles, service accounts, workload identities) against a least-privilege baseline, with permissions that exceed the baseline flagged as posture deviations. Bound to the cloud_misconfiguration playbook's enrich-resource-and-owner step so identity-class deviations carry an owner before the notify step runs.

component.title: Cloud identity least-privilege service
component.description: Continuous and on-demand evaluation of cloud-identity permissions against a least-privilege baseline.

control-implementations.description: Implements access enforcement and least-privilege on cloud identities.

implemented-requirements.description: Access enforcement: cloud-identity permissions are enforced per the operator's policy.
Least privilege: permissions exceeding the baseline are flagged for review.

sources: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 — AC-3 Access Enforcement, AC-6 Least Privilege
ENISA — Cloud Security: identity and access management guidance
MITRE D3FEND v1.0.0 — D3-SCP System Configuration Permissions
